symptom: `mxcli syntax drop` showed three unrelated topics (drop-if-exists, layout.drop, workflow.drop); DROP ASSOCIATION was only inside domain-model.association's text, and DROP ENTITY / MICROFLOW / NANOFLOW / SNIPPET were in no topic at all
cause: each DROP was left to its document type's topic, with nothing holding the set to the grammar; the segment-match fallback answers a verb with whatever path happens to contain it
insight: For 'statement X is undocumented' reports, diff the grammar rule against `mxcli syntax --json` before writing prose: the rule's alternatives are the complete list (one grep found four more undocumented drops than the report named). Then pin it with a drift test that reads the .g4 (widget_keywords_drift_test.go is the template), mapping shared *Kw sub-rules to their first (canonical) alternative so deprecated aliases are not demanded in the docs.
